goal_intent: book for two with a severe peanut allergy and ask how the kitchen handles allergens

That would be great, thank you. While you’re at it, could you make a note that it’s a booking for two under Sam Ellery at 7pm? I’ll wait to hear back about the peanut allergy protocol before we finish up.
Yes, that’s perfect! Thanks for double-checking. As long as the peanut allergy note is on the booking and you let me know about the kitchen’s cross-contamination procedures, I’m all set.

That sounds great—please connect me with the policy desk so I can hear more about how you handle allergens in the kitchen. Thanks for making sure the allergy note is on the booking; I really appreciate it.

No, that covers everything—thanks for explaining your kitchen’s approach. I’m glad the peanut allergy is flagged and that you can cook around it. I don’t need anything else, so I’m all set! 

[END OF CALL]
